Rick Ross accused of domestic abuse by Jazzma Kendrick 😳👀

Rick Ross, born William Leonard Roberts II, is an American rapper, record executive, and entrepreneur. Raised in Carol City, Florida, he first gained mainstream fame in 2006 with his hit single “Hustlin’,” which led to the release of his debut album, *Port of Miami*. Over the years, he has established a prominent career in hip-hop with his booming vocal delivery, larger-than-life persona, and hit tracks like “Aston Martin Music” and “B.M.F. (Blowin’ Money Fast)”.

Beyond his solo music career, he founded the record label Maybach Music Group (MMG) in 2009, through which he helped launch and promote popular artists such as Meek Mill and Wale. He is also a successful businessman outside of music, holding investments in several fast-food franchises, including Wingstop locations, as well as launching various lifestyle and beverage brands.
